name: comment-on-issue-or-pull-request
description: Adds a Markdown comment to a GitHub issue or to a pull request's conversation. The number comes from github__list-issues, github__list-pull-requests or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests, the owner and repository from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

issueNumber.description: The issue's or pull request's number; github__list-issues, github__list-pull-requests or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests answers it.
